attorneys: David Carliner, Herbert Monte Levy, Will Maslow, Arthur Lazarus, Richard Schijter, Jack Wasserman and Edward Ennis for appellant-movant.

opinions.text: Appeal from the Supreme Court of Appeals of Virginia. The motion to recall the mandate and to set the case down for oral argument upon the merits, or, in the alternative, to recall and amend the mandate is denied. The decision of the Supreme Court of Appeals of Virginia of January 18, 1956, 197 Va. 734, 90 S. E. 2d 849, in response to our order of November 14, 1955, 350 U. S. 891, leaves the case devoid of a properly presented federal question.
